description: Find where a React view is used in code. Use its name, testID, text, or nativeTag from describe_screen. Get file paths, lines, and up to six owners. See memo and forwardRef flags too. These paths point to JSX calls. Needs a dev build and Buoy Pro.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

nativeTag.description: The nativeTag from describe_screen. Takes priority over query.

query.description: A component name, testID, or text from describe_screen.

name: get_component_source
